create_Trainer: create a Trainer instance with args, task, model, and criterion for data parallel training
train_step_Trainer: run a training step with forward, backward pass, and parameter update on sample batches
valid_step_Trainer: run a validation step with forward pass in evaluation mode on a single sample
save_checkpoint_Trainer: save all training state including model, optimizer, and meters to a checkpoint file
load_checkpoint_Trainer: load training state from a checkpoint file to resume training with optimizer and lr scheduler
